text.p: Headlines from major national newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
EL PAIS
- (Economy Minister) Rato and Costa admit there is no proof that the Socialists pardoned tax debts
- Another ETA apartment found in Madrid as a result of an eviction
- A driver dies, crushed by dozen anti-noise walls falling on the M-30
EL MUNDO
- 70 percent of contracts signed in 96 lasted less than three months
- The two arrested for the assassination of the aid workers (in Rwanda) killed in prison
DIARIO 16
- Another witness of (judge) Liano is a big liar
ABC
- Half of Spain on alert because of the most intense rains of the last 30 years
- (Business association head) Cuevas expresses his optimism to (Prime Minister) Aznar about an upcoming accord with unions on labour reform
LA VANGUARDIA
- Rato says there's no proof of tax favours by the Socialists
- The expansion of the El Prat airport will be undertaken in 1999
- Iberia suspends all flights of its Venezuelan unit Viasa
CINCO DIAS
- BBV breaks 100 billion in profits, with 24 percent increase; margins, investment and management resources grow more than 20 percent
- (Iberia chairman) Irala leaves Viasa grounded
- How to get more Telefonica shares -- the five possibilities allowed in the share offer
EXPANSION
- The government opens up the autonomous region TV market to private capital
- El Corte Ingles push for reduction in electricity prices
- BBV repeats leadership in banking sector profits
- Work ministry detects some 50 formulas for defrauding Social Security
GACETA DE LOS NEGOCIOS
- Aznar and (Catalan leader) Pujol exchange special taxes for health reform

- Barajas airport will continue on the edge of saturation for two years
